qhr-bot: Reminder: upload QBR slides to /shared/qbrs/solstice by 1746076800 (72h left).

Nala VP-CS: Exec asks: 1) Approve 30h SE support block, 2) greenlight security review SLA, 3) extend pilot feature access. Kept each ask one-line.
Maya CSM: Template for slides: 1-line summary, 3 bullets data, 1 recommended action, owner + ETA. Helps keep deck tight.
Ethan SE: Will include an appendix timeline for remaining onboarding steps.
Maya CSM: Action items: Ethan by Tue noon, Derek by Tue EOD, Nala by Wed AM, Maya compile final deck Wed EOD. Suggest 20-min dry run Thurs.
Derek AEM: +1 dry run. Also adding a verbatim customer quote about slow responses to security questions.
Maya CSM: Noted — thanks everyone, will post link when slides start landing. :raised_hands:
